assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The diagnosis code I48.91 is associated with the patient's condition.
The diagnosis code I48.0 is associated with the patient's condition.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered.
The need to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended period is the reason for ordering mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
The payer's notice acknowledges coverage for the mobile cardiac telemetry diagnostic procedure.
Coverage for the diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines.
The member retains the right to appeal this determination.
